name: 办事大厅
desc: 银行、政务大厅、车站、邮局办事的常用句
descEn: Common phrases for the bank, government hall, station and post office
author: ZiTan 社区 / ZiTan Community

deaf.t: 您好，我听不见，请打字或者看手机
deaf.en: Hi, I'm deaf — please type or look at my phone

deaf.t: 请问办理这个业务要排哪个队
deaf.en: Which queue is for this service?

deaf.t: 请把要准备的材料写给我
deaf.en: Please write down what documents I need
I'd like to open a bank card
I'd like to deposit / withdraw money
Where do I get my social security card?

deaf.t: 我要办理这项业务（指手机屏幕）
deaf.en: I'd like to do this (point at phone)

deaf.t: 请问身份证丢了怎么补办
deaf.en: How do I replace a lost ID card?
Which floor is the waiting hall?

deaf.t: 我要寄一个快递，怎么填单
deaf.en: I'd like to mail a parcel — how do I fill the form?

vol.en: Hello, please take a number first

vol.t: 这项业务需要填写这张表
vol.en: This service requires filling out this form

vol.t: 办理时间大约需要十分钟

vol.en: The window is third on the left
Your documents are ready, one moment
It's done — here is your receipt
